decisions: The broad navy illustrated eye region is shaded iris, not the literal black pupil. Keep neutral pupil centered for coherent aim.

Purposeful cage changes are four iris/pupil meshes, four lids and the existing #37 mask bridge. Both eye aim pivots move 6 mm back in Y; X/Z arrangement, relative globe/cornea envelopes, both masks, all feather seats, the other 90 non-eye full states and studio stay fixed. Four-view comparison justifies the reduced eye projection against 07/08.
Logo warm accent is restricted to the lower peripheral iris arc, never a full orange ring.

Cornea uses a thin Fresnel transparent/glossy coating for the frozen non-raytraced Eevee studio; real layered geometry remains editable. Full refractive raytracing is outside this fixed-studio milestone.
Restrained iris emission supports the branded luminous color under the unchanged neutral validation lighting; feather/body emission remains unchanged.
Network is an object-space procedural shader with parameterized segments/nodes; it moves with each eye and adds no collision geometry. Catchlights come from the real fixed area lights.

A parameterized Eevee ShaderToRGB gain32, luminance core response and concentration384 amplify and concentrate the actual glossy light response around view-dependent reflection directions to the five unchanged studio lights. Grazing coat is capped at0.10. No painted highlight positions; this artistic compensation is not a physical energy-conserving raytraced cornea.

The smaller eye projection shortens the lid mantle. Inner front/back rows follow the 6-mm eye depth correction; outer lid rows and mask attachments stay fixed. Authored radial front/back normals separate the closed endcaps to remove the artificial canthus shading seam.

The existing #37 bridge is widened locally to close actual medial head exposure. Its Y/Z, topology, thickness, lower and upper anchors stay fixed; measured gap coordinates and full gaze/beak probes determine the bounded width profile.

Fresh scene opens must call eyes_geometry.configure_lids(root); use eyes_geometry.set_blink(root, values) for visual poses so authored normals follow the actual deformed cages. Historical face helpers and files are unchanged.
